lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Thanksgiving morning, sun begins to gleam
The family's gathering, living out a dream
Turkey in the oven, pies all lined up neat
But something's brewing, can't be beat
Sierra Zemke's got a story, whispers in the hall
About a Jedi master, standing proud and tall
Obi-Wan in jail, the news has spread so far
While Kirk Cameron's preaching, playing his guitar

[Chorus]
Oh, Thanksgiving day, a feast for all to see
With secret farts on YouTube, for the world to agree
Jar Jar Binks is laughing, from a galaxy away
It's a bizarre holiday, in every single way

[Verse 2]
Dinner's on the table, laughter fills the air
Gravy on the mashed potatoes, without a care
Uncle Bob tells stories, of birds that fly in jail
And a gun that shot no bullets, an unbelievable tale
We're watching viral videos, a screen aglow and bright
Someone caught a moment, a comedic sight
Of gas escaping quickly, a sound both deep and low
And everyone's just giggling, because they know, they know

[Chorus]
Oh, Thanksgiving day, a feast for all to see
With secret farts on YouTube, for the world to agree
Jar Jar Binks is laughing, from a galaxy away
It's a bizarre holiday, in every single way

[Bridge]
From Hollywood to kitchens, the strange tales intertwine
Of movie stars and flatulence, a truly wild design
Who knew that these odd pieces, would fit into one day?
But on Thanksgiving, anything can go astray

[Chorus]
Oh, Thanksgiving day, a feast for all to see
With secret farts on YouTube, for the world to agree
Jar Jar Binks is laughing, from a galaxy away
It's a bizarre holiday, in every single way

[Outro]
So pass the cranberry sauce, and don't forget the pie
Another year of weirdness, as the hours fly by
Happy Thanksgiving, everyone, let the good times roll
With YouTube farts and Jedi tales, reaching every soul.

The arrangement gradually builds, introducing a subtle, downtempo lo-fi hip-hop beat with a soft kick and snare, complemented by a warm bassline and atmospheric synth pads. The track maintains a tranquil and introspective mood throughout, with the piano and flute weaving in and out, creating a serene soundscape perfect for relaxation or contemplation. The song concludes with a beautiful instrumental outro featuring the piano and flute, fading into silence.
lyrics:
[Intro: Piano & Flute]

[Verse 1]
静かな森 歩み寄る
木々のざわめき 聞こえる音
陽射しが揺れて 影踊る
心は軽く 自由になる

[Verse 2]
風が通り 抱きしめるように
葉は止ま 語る古い物語
小鳥の歌が 空を仰ぎ
その音色だけ 生きている

[Chorus]
森の中で 消えてゆく
小さな悩み 風に乗る
心地良い緑 包まれて
私は癒され 生まれ変わる

[Instrumental Break: Piano, Flute, Drums]

[Verse 3]
土の匂いが 深く染みる
地球の鼓動 感じている
目を閉じ夜明けを 夢見て
自然と溶ける 虚無する

[Verse 4]
月の光が ゆっくりと
静けさ抱え 手ら知ってる
心がささやく 小さな声
森のリズムで 調和化する

[Chorus]
森の中で 消えてゆく
小さな悩み 風に乗る
心地良い緑 包まれて
私は癒され 生まれ変わる

[Outro: Piano & Flute]

lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
交易命运的改变 源头在起心动念
这是改变的关键 但很多人视而不见
大赚大亏踏空卖飞 内在秩序不要乱
保持平和的心念 净值弹指间改变
当你大赚庆幸时 请你安静想想看
这笔盈利隐含多少潜在代价来交换
当你清楚知晓每次交易对应的代价
策略的赔率带给你先胜后战的心安

[Pre-Chorus]
当你选择策略保守会避开一些风险
模式内机会出现时进攻必然受限
当你选择激进策略博弈猛干一段
大赚的概率提升 大面概率也提升

[Chorus]
当你大亏懊悔时 请你冷静想想看
当下的首要任务是稳住还是继续猛干
如果内心秩序混乱还想力挽狂澜
连续重仓猛干会让你连续吃大面
此时赶紧降低期待调整心中的不甘
要警惕出其不意博弈小概率事件

[Verse 2]
因为赌性会在不顺之时出来作乱
回头发现 努力回血反而不如摆烂
当你交易卖飞时
请你转念想想看 后续行情是否出现一个更好的答案
其实时间拉长看 每条净值的曲线
那是模式画的图
更是心性的变现

[Bridge]
世间 一切都是万物因缘合和的结果
很多事
都不是我们想怎样就怎样的
走势无常才是交易基本的常态
于是先要接纳它 否则痛苦一直在
所有绊脚石
换个角度也是垫脚石
在你主动站上去看更高的风景时

[Verse 3]
当你后悔当初时 请你转念想想看
难道当初不那样 做现在真的会更棒 不那样现在会怎样
都是你的想象
况且日子还很长 不要过早下判
